name: Skippy ghost rims
desc: 707 rimshot skips with heavy ghost-note dynamics and late-pattern shuffle, shaker eighths panning on a slow sine, cowbell euclid rotating its offset with an 8-bar ply fill. Dub delay owns orbit 2.

rate.doc: pattern rate multiplier, bare JS arg

code.full: stack(s("[~ rim ~ rim] [~ ~ rim ~] [~ rim ~ ~] [rim ~ <rim ~> rim]").bank("RolandTR707").shape(.2).gain("[.45 .2 .32 .18]*4").late("[0 .02]*8").delay(${dly}), s("sh*8").gain("[.3 .12 .2 .1]*2").pan(sine.range(.25,.75).slow(32)), s("cb(2,8,<0 3 6 1>)").bank("RolandTR707").gain(.2).every(8, x=>x.ply(2))).fast(${rate}).orbit(2).play()
code.peak: stack(s("[rim ~ rim rim] [~ rim rim ~] [rim rim ~ rim] [~ rim rim <rim [rim rim]>]").bank("RolandTR707").shape(.25).gain("[.48 .22 .35 .2]*4").late("[0 .018]*8").delay(${dly}), s("sh*16").gain("[.32 .14 .22 .12]*4").pan(sine.range(.2,.8).slow(16)), s("cb(3,8,<0 2 4 6>)").bank("RolandTR707").gain(.22), s("tb(3,16,<0 4 8 12>)").gain(.18).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2))).fast(${rate}).orbit(2).play()
